company.description:
Meteor is a 100% remote company that covers the massive disruptions caused by new technologies like AI, Web3, and NFTs.  

Meteor is centered on the upcoming aspects of subjects that arouse enthusiasm, ranging from art, games, and music to media and sports.

The company was founded in 2022 by Neil Katz and Evan Hansen.
